caption: The drawing depicts two detailed graphite illustrations of a spoon on an off-white background, arranged horizontally and parallel to each other within a lightly outlined rectangular border. Each spoon is shown in a side-by-side orientation, revealing both the top and underside of the utensil. The upper illustration shows the top view of the spoon, with a gently curved bowl, a long handle, and a monogram or script engraving visible on the handle’s end. The lower illustration presents the bottom view, displaying a hallmark or maker's mark on the handle and faint design details near the handle's end. Both illustrations are rendered in shades of gray, simulating light and shadow to highlight the metallic surface and three-dimensional shape. In the bottom left corner of the drawing, there is an additional small technical diagram of the spoon, displaying its outline with labeled dimensions and measurements, and text indicating scale. The overall composition is precise and technical, focusing on the accurate depiction and dimensions of the spoon.
title: Silver Spoon
